units.source_text: 次日早晨，雪已积得很厚。

en.t: By the next morning, the snow had already piled up deeply.

units.source_text: 大家把昨日所作诗歌呈请御览。

en.t: Everyone presented the poems they had composed the day before for imperial viewing.

units.source_text: 匂亲王此时正值盛年，站在御前，风姿异常优美。

en.t: Prince Niou was then in the prime of youth, and as he stood before His Majesty, his bearing was extraordinarily graceful.

units.source_text: 薰大将年龄和他相仿，恐是稍长二三岁之故，

en.t: General Kaoru was about the same age as he was, though perhaps because he was two or three years older,

units.source_text: 态度神情比他老成些，仿佛有意做作似的，

en.t: his manner and expression seemed somewhat more mature, almost as if deliberately composed,

units.source_text: 竟是一个高尚贵公子的范本。

en.t: and he was truly a model of the noble aristocratic gentleman.

units.source_text: 世人都赞誉他，说他当皇帝的女婿毫无不足之处。

en.t: People everywhere praised him, saying that he lacked nothing as a son-in-law for the Emperor.

units.source_text: 他在学问方面和政治方面都不落人后。

en.t: In both scholarship and affairs of government, he fell behind no one.

units.source_text: 诗歌披诵既毕，大家从御前退出。

en.t: When the poems had been presented and recited, everyone withdrew from the imperial presence.

units.source_text: 人都称道匂亲王所作诗歌优秀，大声吟诵。

en.t: People praised the excellence of Prince Niou's poem and recited it aloud.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王本人全然不觉得高兴。

en.t: But Prince Niou himself felt no happiness at all.

units.source_text: 他想：“这些人怎么有闲情逸致来吟诵诗歌？”

en.t: He thought, "How can these people have the leisure and taste to recite poetry?"

units.source_text: 他对诗歌心不在焉，一味想念着浮舟。

en.t: His mind was not on the poems; he thought only of Ukifune.
